attempts.name: banner-hard
attempts.prompt: Create one premium polished mobile game UI asset: a blank horizontal orange capsule banner, transparent RGBA background. Reference image is a rough PROGRAM MOCKUP: use only its capsule proportion, orange palette and overall game style, do not include any other items. Final capsule width:height is exactly 840:220 (3.818:1); horizontal, NOT tilted, perfectly semicircular left and right ends, symmetric. Front surface top bright warm orange #FFB547 fading vertically to orange-red #FF6A3D at bottom. Visible thick soft bevel/extrusion along bottom in deep orange-red #D2452A. A broad soft white translucent upper highlight gives gentle rounded light-3D volume; upper-right lighting. A single fine white dashed stitched seam runs inset along the full capsule outline, like a carefully sewn plush fabric rim. A sparse extremely faint white outlined small bubble-circle pattern printed inside, low contrast, especially keep the center quiet for separate text. Smooth premium plush-cloth surface with only subtle microtexture, not shaggy fur or grainy rough noise. Carefully refined curves, rounded edges, clean soft studio shading, rich bright colors. ONLY THE BLANK CAPSULE. No text or letters at all, no badge, face, stars, lightning, flare, background, surrounding glow or detached shadow. Center in a wide transparent canvas, make the complete banner as large as possible without cropping its edges. No white rectangular background or white outer border.

attempts.name: ribbon-hard
attempts.prompt: Create ONE isolated orange horizontal full-screen RIBBON STRIP for a mobile game difficulty entrance, transparent RGBA PNG. The reference is a rough layout mockup; use only orange palette and the long flat screen-spanning ribbon design. OUTPUT ONLY THE RIBBON, no bear, words, stars, lightning, sweep-glow or background. FINAL GEOMETRY: a straight horizontal PARALLELOGRAM, 1400x280 intended delivery canvas. Main cloth band roughly 250 px high. Both ends cleanly cut on a slant: each top corner lies about 60 px to the RIGHT of its corresponding bottom corner. Top and bottom edges straight, horizontal, parallel. All FOUR corners are crisp (only antialiasing, no rounding); NO semicircular ends, NO capsule, NO pill, NO button, NO raised bezel or thick extrusion. A flat, subtle fine plush textile ribbon, top bright orange #FFB547 grading vertically to orange-red #FF6A3D. One THIN highlight along the very top edge. Two fine white dashed stitch lines only along the upper and lower long edges. Underneath it is ONE same-shaped dark-orange #9C2F14 parallelogram shadow strip, shifted DOWN by about 20 final px, opacity about 60%; clean hard slanted silhouette, no blurred ground shadow. The white motif near EACH end is exactly TWO rightward chevrons made of round white bubbles: each chevron has exactly FIVE separate circles arranged as > (upper-left dot, upper-right dot, tip-right dot in middle, lower-right dot, lower-left dot). Thus TEN circles at left end and TEN circles at right end; no solid arrow lines, no connecting lines. Left group printed faintly, right group brighter. Keep the broad CENTER entirely clear of decorations and text for a separate title. Circle motifs small enough to fit fully inside the band and not touch the stitch lines. Premium clean detailed game art but relatively FLAT CLOTH, very restrained texture/light, not glossy inflated plastic. Squarely horizontal asset; the engine applies its upward 6-degree tilt later. Wide transparent composition showing the entire complete parallelogram including both slanted ends and translucent under-strip; no clipping.

attempts.name: ribbon-hard
attempts.prompt: Revise reference image 1, ONLY the orange cloth ribbon geometry/proportions and shadow opacity. Keep its orange gradient, flat fabric, horizontal top/bottom dashed stitching, empty center, and EXACT existing bubble-dot motif: TEN round white dots at EACH end arranged as two > chevrons of five dots each. Preserve the very good non-button, non-capsule design. The previous ribbon is too thin and the two end cuts are too shallow. Make the colored cloth face taller: full visible composite including shadow must have WIDTH:HEIGHT exactly 5:1 (1400:280), not the previous roughly 8:1. Geometry measured on a 1400x280 final canvas: main face vertices TOP-LEFT (64,2), TOP-RIGHT (1396,2), BOTTOM-RIGHT (1336,256), BOTTOM-LEFT (4,256). Therefore both short edges are steep slanted straight cuts, horizontal offset ONLY 60 px across 254 px vertical height (about 77 degrees to horizontal). Top and bottom long edges perfectly straight horizontal, absolutely no rounded corners or inflated bevel. Beneath the face, same-shape dark #9C2F14 shadow shifted VERTICALLY DOWN only 20 px, not shifted sideways. This shadow layer must be SEMITRANSPARENT at approximately 60 percent opacity, with transparent background visible through it. No opaque thick red bottom extrusion. Main face is opaque, flat cloth top #FFB547 to bottom #FF6A3D; thin top highlight, no glossy button shine. White bubble dots must stay perfectly circular despite taller band. Left motif fainter than right motif; no new dots. Make the 1400:280 composite wide and centered on a generous transparent canvas; it may occupy a wider canvas with transparent top/bottom padding, but the actual silhouette itself must be 5:1. Render large at high resolution, retain clean anti-aliased edges and all corners. No text, bear, stars, lightning or any additional objects. Image 2 is the composition reference only. Only one static horizontal parallelogram ribbon.

attempts.name: badge-hard
attempts.prompt: Create one polished mobile game UI badge, transparent RGBA background. The reference is a rough PROGRAM MOCKUP; refine its orange angry bubble badge, preserve the overall round orange bubble and friendly angry expression, not the crude geometry. A single perfectly round glossy orange bubble sphere, base orange #FF8A3D, bright warm orange front with subtle orange-red shading toward the lower rim, one tasteful soft large glossy highlight at UPPER LEFT as specifically required for this badge. The sphere has a clean thick opaque WHITE outer outline around the entire circumference, about 4 percent of the diameter; gently rounded bevel, polished light 3D. Face centered: two simple small ROUND dark-brown dot eyes, clearly lowered angry eyebrows with rounded ends angled inward; a small soft downturned frown, cute frustrated determined expression, friendly not frightening. Eyes stay circular and open; eyebrows separate from eyes. No teeth, no open mouth, no nose, no horns for this difficulty tier. Smooth bright glossy bubble material, crisp professionally finished shapes. Final asset 300 by 300 square, circle fills most of the canvas evenly with a tiny transparent antialias safety margin. Do NOT include any stars, banner, text, lightning, sparkle, skull, spikes, scary elements, floor shadow, background or surrounding glow. One static isolated badge only.

attempts.name: bear-hard
attempts.prompt: Create one transparent RGBA game character sprite: the exact BLUE PLUSH BEAR BOBO sitting in his BLUE CLOUD-DECORATED FLOWERPOT, using reference 1 for character identity, royal-azure blue fur, cream muzzle and inner ears, brown nose, green paired leaves, same pot silhouette/color/light-blue puffy cloud decorations and small circle decorations. Reference 2 is ONLY headband color and overall scale placement. CRITICAL NEW POSE -- DO NOT COPY EITHER REFERENCE'S RAISED-ARM CHEERING POSE. Both arms are bent with ELBOWS DOWN tight beside the torso; BOTH LITTLE PAWS ARE CLENCHED INTO FISTS HELD CLOSE IN FRONT OF THE UPPER CHEST, immediately BELOW THE CHIN, like saying 'Let's do this!' and pumping oneself up before a challenge. Both fists at chest height near each other, never raised beside the ears or above the cheeks; no arms stretched sideways/upward, no victory cheer, no waving. Fists show soft curled plush fingers/knuckle folds and tucked thumbs, no human fingers or fingernails. Expression: eyes OPEN and focused with small natural catchlights, slightly drawn-together eyebrows, determined but very cute and friendly; mouth OPEN calling encouragement, cream muzzle retained, small tongue visible; not anger, not fear, not closed-eye cheering. Wear a RED CLOTH HEADBAND #E8322E across the FOREHEAD ABOVE THE EYEBROWS. The entire eyes and eyebrows remain unobscured. Band tied in one small neat knot on screen RIGHT with TWO SHORT red ribbon tails extending slightly outward, all fully within canvas. Fine fabric seams and folds in band, not a flat crude drawn polygon. Plush bear light comes softly from UPPER RIGHT, furry 3D and round, matching reference 1. Same BLUE CLOUD POT and TWO BIG GREEN LEAVES in front of the lower torso; do not swap pot for a paw-print pot or orange pot. Both elbows attach naturally to the shoulders; paws clearly in FRONT of chest ABOVE the leaves, not mounted on pot sides. Entire character and pot visible, portrait ratio 360:400 with modest transparent padding, ears, headband tails and fists all fully inside canvas. ONLY the sprite. No text, no stars, no sparkles, no badge circle, no white outline, no flames, no glow, no confetti, no background or floor shadow. A static one-frame 'fists ready / give myself encouragement' stance, absolutely NOT raised-arm cheering.

attempts.name: title-hard
attempts.prompt: Create a standalone polished Chinese game title wordmark on a truly transparent RGBA background. Exact text, exactly FOUR simplified Chinese characters in this order: 困难关卡 . Character-by-character: 困 / 难 / 关 / 卡 . Do not add spaces, punctuation, other words or extra symbols. Reference image is only rough layout and color guidance; redraw as premium rounded fat bold typography with soft corners, balanced readable strokes and uniform baseline, horizontal NOT tilted. All FOUR character faces pure warm WHITE with very subtle soft upper-right light bevel, no colored front fills. Thick unified deep burnt-orange outline #9C2F14 around all strokes and counterforms; below the outline add a second lower extrusion/thickness layer in orange-red #D2452A creating short rounded 3D depth. Characters have roomy readable inner counters, neither fragile thin strokes nor square harsh industrial type. Specifically check 困 is an enclosing box with 木 inside; 难 is 又 plus 隹; 关 is the standard simplified 关; 卡 is the standard 卡. Do not stylize away or merge components. Only the four-character wordmark, no capsule/banner, badge, faces, stars, sparks, effects, background, floor shadow, glow, English or Latin letters. Final output intended for 680 by 180, wide ratio around 3.78:1, large readable glyphs distributed across the width with equal balanced spacing, fully visible outline and bottom thickness without clipping. Render large in a wide transparent canvas with tight even safety margins.

export_method: Uniform aspect-preserving resampling with premultiplied alpha into requested transparent canvases; selected generated masters untouched; approved K5 untouched. K1 retains original translucent shadow.
